usedFor: Shopify holds your catalog, and Frill collects feedback, so “New Product” can open an idea through “Create Idea”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Idea” in Frill
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets an idea where customers can weigh in, with author and topics set on creation.

watchOut: “New Product” fires only on creation, so later edits to a product do not change its idea.
